name: ukraine-vat
description: Ukrainian value added tax (podatok na dodanu vartist, PDV) for tax year 2026 under section V of the Tax Code of Ukraine as amended to September 2026. Covers who must register (UAH 1,000,000 in 12 months; single-tax groups 1 to 3 excluded), the 20%, 14%, 7% and 0% rates and what sits at each, exempt and out-of-scope supplies, place of supply, the tax point, input VAT and the 365-day claim window, the pro-rata rule, the electronic administration system (SEA) registration limit, tax invoice registration deadlines and the martial-law penalty scale, invoice blocking, refunds, the reverse charge on services from non-residents, non-resident e-services, the monthly return by the 20th and payment 10 days later, and the martial-law rules. Trigger on: Ukraine VAT, PDV return, register for VAT in Ukraine, tax invoice registration, SEA VAT limit. Out of scope: invoice mechanics in detail (ua-einvoice), single tax (ua-single-tax), corporate income tax (ua-corporate-income-tax), country summary (ua-t
